text: The 2026 Dubai World Cup (30th running, 28 March 2026, Meydan) carried a $12 million purse 'sponsored by Emirates'; the meeting's total purse is US$30.5 million across nine races, organised by Dubai Racing Club.
short: 2026 Dubai World Cup $12m purse sponsored by Emirates

source.name: Emirates 24|7 - Magnitude wins Dubai World Cup 2026 at Meydan Racecourse
source.quote: Magnitude secured the $6.96 million winner’s prize from the total $12 million purse sponsored by Emirates.
